BU BET — GRAMMAR BOOK'NING OLD
MUQOVASI.

  Mashq yo'q, bet raqami ham yo'q.


MUQOVADA NIMA BOR:

  1) SERIYA NOMI:
     'ENTERPRISE' — yashil harflar,
     binafsha fonda

  2) NAShR TURI:
     'Student's Book' — o'quvchi kitobi

  3) KITOB TURI VA RAQAMI:
     'GRAMMAR 1' — pushti harflar,
     '1' binafsha rangda

  4) MUALLIFLAR:
     Virginia Evans - Jenny Dooley

  5) NAShRIYOT:
     Express Publishing

  6) BEZAK:
     O'ng yuqorida porlayotgan YULDUZ
     (Workbook muqovasidagi kabi).


⚠ 'STUDENT'S BOOK' NIMA DEGANI — MUHIM:

  Express Publishing har kitobning IKKI
  xil nashrini chiqaradi:

     'STUDENT'S BOOK' — O'QUVChI uchun
        (javoblar YO'Q)

     'TEACHER'S BOOK' — O'QITUVChI uchun
        (javoblar BOR, qo'shimcha
         ko'rsatmalar bilan)

  ⚠ Bizdagi nusxa — O'QUVChI nashri.
  Shuning uchun kitobda javoblar
  bosilmagan.

  ⚠ Bu — nega ba'zi mashqlarda 'kitob
  javobni bosmagan' deb yozganimizning
  sababi!


⚠ EGALIK ShAKLI — 'STUDENT'S':

  'a student'S book' = o'quvchining kitobi
  'a teacher'S book' = o'qituvchining kitobi

  Birlik ot → apostrof + s.

  ⚠ KO'PLIKDA boshqacha bo'lardi:
     'the studentS' books' = o'quvchilarning
        kitoblari
     (apostrof '-s' DAN KEYIN)


⚠ MUQOVANING RANGLARI:

  Kitob to'plamining har qismi BOShQA
  rangda:

     COURSEBOOK — o'z rangi
     WORKBOOK — YAShIL
     GRAMMAR — YAShIL va BINAFShA

  Bu — kitoblarni tez ajratish uchun.


⚠ WORKBOOK MUQOVASI BILAN FARQI:

  WORKBOOK (yashil):
     shamol tegirmoni surati bor
     'workbook' kichik harflar bilan

  GRAMMAR (yashil + binafsha):
     surat YO'Q, faqat rang va yulduz
     'GRAMMAR' KATTA harflar bilan


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  grammar     = grammatika
  a Student's Book = o'quvchi kitobi
  a Teacher's Book = o'qituvchi kitobi
  a star      = yulduz
  to shine    = porlamoq
  purple      = binafsha
  pink        = pushti

exercises.instructionEn: Contents — Unit 1 to Unit 15, Irregular Verbs, Progress Tests
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — GRAMMAR BOOK'NING MUNDARIJASI.

  Kitobning 3-beti. Mashq yo'q.


⚠ WORKBOOK MUNDARIJASIDAN MUHIM FARQI:

  WORKBOOK mundarijasida unit nomlari
  MAQOL edi:
     'A Friend in Need...'
     'Birds of a Feather...'

  GRAMMAR mundarijasida esa har unitning
  GRAMMATIK MAVZULARI berilgan:
     'Subject Pronouns - The Verb "to be"
      - Indefinite Article A/An'

  ⚠ Ya'ni bu mundarija — BUTUN KITOBNING
  GRAMMATIKA DASTURI. Uni o'qib chiqsangiz,
  bir yilda nima o'rganishingizni bilasiz.


BETLAR ORALIG'I — DIQQAT:

  Ko'p unitlar 4 betdan:
     4, 8, 12, ..., 22, 26, 30, 34, 38

  ⚠ LEKIN IKKI ISTISNO BOR:

     Unit 4  — 16-21 bet (OLTI bet!)
        keyingi unit 22-betdan
     Unit 10 — 42-47 bet (OLTI bet!)
        keyingi unit 48-betdan

  Sababi: bu ikki unitda MAVZU KO'P.
     Unit 4 — olmoshlar, egalik,
        buyruq gap, Present Simple
     Unit 10 — Past Simple, artikllar,
        will, bog'lovchilar

  ⚠ Workbook'da har unit ANIQ 4 betdan
  edi — Grammar Book'da esa mavzuga qarab
  o'zgaradi.


OXIRGI IKKI QATOR:

  'Irregular Verbs   p. 68'
  'Progress Tests    p. 69'

  ⚠ Bularda UNIT raqami YO'Q — ular unit
  emas, qo'shimcha bo'limlar.

  ⚠ 'Irregular Verbs' — Coursebook'ning
  116-betida ham bor edi (111 ta fe'l).


⚠ GRAMMATIK ATAMALAR — LUG'AT:

  a subject pronoun = ega olmoshi
     (I, you, he, she, it, we, they)
  an object pronoun = to'ldiruvchi olmoshi
     (me, you, him, her, it, us, them)
  a possessive = egalik shakli
     (my, your, his, her ...)
  the possessive case = egalik kelishigi
     (John'S book)
  an article = artikl (a, an, the)
  indefinite article = noaniq artikl (a/an)
  a plural = ko'plik
  irregular plurals = noto'g'ri ko'pliklar
     (man → men)
  a preposition = predlog
     of place = joy predloglari (in, on)
     of time = vaqt predloglari (at, on, in)
     of movement = harakat predloglari
        (into, out of)
  an adverb = ravish
  adverbs of frequency = takrorlanish
     ravishlari (always, never)
  an adjective = sifat
  a countable noun = sanaladigan ot
  an uncountable noun = sanalmaydigan ot
  the imperative = buyruq gap
  linking words = bog'lovchilar
  comparisons = qiyoslash
  irregular verbs = noto'g'ri fe'llar


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  contents    = mundarija
  a syllabus  = dastur
  a topic     = mavzu
  an exception = istisno

MUQOVADA NIMA BOR:

  1) KITOB TURI:

     (a windmill). Chap tomonda yashil

⚠ 'WORKBOOK' NIMA DEGANI:

  'work' + 'book' = ish + kitob
  = mashqlar daftari

  Qo'shma ot — ikki so'zdan yasalgan,

  Shunga o'xshash:
     'a notebook' = daftar
     'a textbook' = darslik
     'a handbook' = qo'llanma
     'a cookbook' = oshpazlik kitobi

  'enterprise' = 1) tashabbus, jasorat
                 2) korxona

  Kitob nomi sifatida — 'jur'at, yangi
  ishga qo'l urish' ma'nosida.

  Enterprise seriyasining darajalari:
     Enterprise 1 — Beginner (boshlovchi)
     Enterprise 2 — Elementary
     Enterprise 3 — Pre-Intermediate
     Enterprise 4 — Intermediate

  'begin' + '-er' = beginNer
  (⚠ 'n' ikkilanadi)


MUALLIFLAR HAQIDA:

  Virginia Evans va Jenny Dooley —
  Express Publishing nashriyotining
  eng ko'p kitob yozgan mualliflari.

  a workbook  = mashqlar daftari
  a coursebook = darslik
  a windmill  = shamol tegirmoni
  a beginner  = boshlovchi
  a cover     = muqova

⚠ 'ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS' — QIYIN SO'Z:

  'to acknowledge' = tan olmoq, e'tirof
     etmoq
  'acknowledgements' = minnatdorchilik
     (kitobda)

  ⚠ YOZILIShI: acknowledgeMENTs
  (BrE) yoki acknowledgMENTs (AmE) —
  'e' bor yoki yo'q.

  ⚠ TALAFFUZ: /əkˈnɒlɪdʒmənts/ —
  boshidagi 'ac-' /ək/ deb o'qiladi.


⚠ GRAMMATIKA — 'WISH TO':

  'The authors WISH TO THANK ...'
  = mualliflar rahmat aytmoqchi

  ⚠ 'wish to' — RASMIY shakl.
  Kundalik nutqda: 'want to'.

     'I WISH TO thank you.'  (rasmiy)
     'I WANT TO thank you.'  (oddiy)


⚠ GRAMMATIKA — PRESENT PERFECT:

  'who HAVE kindly GIVEN permission'
  'Every effort HAS BEEN MADE ...'
  'if any HAVE BEEN inadvertently
   overlooked'

  ⚠ Uchalasi ham Present Perfect —
  natijasi HOZIR muhim.

  ⚠ 'has been made' va 'have been
  overlooked' — MAJHUL Present Perfect.


DIQQAT — 'KINDLY':
  'kindly' = xayrixohlik bilan, mehribonlik
     bilan

  'kind' (mehribon) + '-ly' = ravish

  ⚠ Rasmiy matnlarda ko'p ishlatiladi.


DIQQAT — 'INADVERTENTLY':
  'inadvertently' = beixtiyor, bilmasdan

  ⚠ 'in-' — inkor prefiksi
  ('advertent' = diqqatli)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  acknowledgements = minnatdorchilik
  to acknowledge = tan olmoq
  to thank    = rahmat aytmoq
  kindly      = xayrixohlik bilan
  permission  = ruxsat

  to overlook = e'tibordan chetda qoldirmoq

  Unit 12  See New Places,
           Meet New Faces             p. 48
  Unit 13  Time will Tell             p. 52
  Unit 14  Dos and Don'ts             p. 56
  Unit 15  Take a Break               p. 60
           Progress Tests             p. 65

  4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 36, 40,
  44, 48, 52, 56, 60

  Har raqam oldingisidan 4 ga katta!

  Ya'ni har unitga ANIQ TO'RT bet
  ajratilgan — kitob juda tartibli
  tuzilgan.

  15 unit × 4 bet = 60 bet
  (4-betdan 63-betgacha)


⚠ UNIT NOMLARI — DEYARLI HAMMASI
INGLIZ MAQOLI YOKI IBORASI:

  2  'A Friend in Need...'
     To'liq maqol: 'A friend in need is a
     friend indeed.'
     = Do'st boshga kulfat tushganda
       bilinadi.
     ⚠ 1-nazorat testining 15-bandi aynan
     shu maqol edi!

     = Uy — eng shirin joy.

     = Otasiga o'xshaydi (qanday ota —
       shunday o'g'il).

     'an early bird' = erta turadigan odam
     'a night owl' = kechasi uxlamaydigan
        odam
     ⚠ 'The early bird catches the worm.'
       = Erta turgan yutadi.

  6  'Birds of a Feather...'
     To'liq maqol: 'Birds of a feather
     flock together.'
     = Bir xil qushlar birga uchadi
       (o'xshashlar bir yerga to'planadi).

  7  'Come Rain or Shine'
     = Yomg'irmi, quyoshmi — baribir
       (har qanday holatda).

  9  'Times Change...'
     = Zamonlar o'zgaradi.

 11  'All's Well that Ends Well'
     = Oxiri yaxshi bo'lsa, hammasi
       yaxshi.
     ⚠ Bu — Shekspirning komediyasi nomi
     ham!

 12  'See New Places, Meet New Faces'
     = Yangi joylarni ko'r, yangi
       yuzlarni uchrat.
     ⚠ QOFIYA: plACES — fACES.

 13  'Time will Tell'
     = Vaqt ko'rsatadi (kelajakda
       ma'lum bo'ladi).

 14  'Dos and Don'ts'
     = Mumkin va mumkin emas (qoidalar).
     ⚠ 'a do' = qilish kerak bo'lgan ish
       'a don't' = qilmaslik kerak

 15  'Take a Break'
     = Dam ol, tanaffus qil.


⚠ KITOBDAGI BOSMA XATO (14-unit):

  Kitobda: 'Dos and Don´ts'
  To'g'ri:  'Dos and Don'ts'

  'Video Projects   p. 83'

  ⚠ Bularda UNIT raqami YO'Q — chunki ular
  unit emas, qo'shimcha bo'limlar.

sentencePatterns.exampleUz: ENTERPRISE 1, boshlovchilar uchun — Virjiniya Evans, Jenni Duli — Express Publishing

sentencePatterns.formula: This book is WRITTEN BY [muallif] and PUBLISHED BY [nashriyot].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This book is written by Virginia Evans and Jenny Dooley, and published by Express Publishing.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu kitobni Virjiniya Evans va Jenni Duli yozgan, Express Publishing nashr qilgan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ MAJHUL nisbat: 'is written BY',
'is published BY' — ish bajaruvchi 'by'
bilan.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Published by Express Publishing. © Virginia Evans - Jenny Dooley, 1997.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Express Publishing nashr qilgan. © Virjiniya Evans - Jenni Duli, 1997.

sentencePatterns.formula: No part of this publication MAY BE + [V3] ... without the prior written permission of ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: No part of this publication may be reproduced ... without the prior written permission of the Publishers.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu nashrning hech bir qismi Nashriyotning oldindan yozma ruxsatisiz ko'paytirilishi mumkin emas.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ MAJHUL nisbat + 'may'.
'NO part ... may be ...' — inkor ma'no.

sentencePatterns.formula: The authors WISH TO THANK ... who HAVE kindly GIVEN permission ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The authors and publishers wish to thank the following who have kindly given permission.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mualliflar va nashriyot ruxsat berganlarga minnatdorchilik bildiradi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'wish to' — rasmiy ('want to' — oddiy).
'have given' — Present Perfect.

sentencePatterns.formula: Every effort HAS BEEN MADE to + [ASOSIY fe'l].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Every effort has been made to trace all the copyright holders.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Barcha huquq egalarini topishga harakat qilindi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ MAJHUL Present Perfect — rasmiy matnlarda
ko'p uchraydi.
